findings.title: Sub-line code-screen scroll
findings.detail: The code group wraps on `% LINE_SPACING` (0.12) instead of the full `CODE_SPAN`, so the 'streaming code' is a small oscillating shift that snaps back rather than a continuous scroll. Cosmetic only; well inside the plan's tunable-visual-quality latitude. To get a true stream, wrap on CODE_SPAN with duplicated/tiled lines filling the vacated space.

findings.title: Dead constant CODE_SPAN
findings.detail: `CODE_SPAN` is computed but never referenced; it appears to have been intended as the scroll wrap distance. Either use it (see finding above) or remove it. If a strict no-unused-vars lint run flags it, that is the only lint risk.
